description: This file defines the LoanAccountLockService interface within the Fineract project, specifying methods related to handling loan account locks in the context of the batch operation system.

classes.name: LoanAccountLockService
classes.description: Interface defining services related to loan account locking, including retrieval, status checking, and lock management.

methods.name: getLockedLoanAccountByPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of locked loan accounts.

methods.name: isLoanHardLocked
methods.description: Checks if a specific loan is hard locked.

methods.name: isLockOverrulable
methods.description: Determines if the lock on a specific loan can be overridden.

methods.name: updateCobAndRemoveLocks
methods.description: Updates the Collection of Batches (COB) and removes existing locks.
